package.description: A helper application designed to make using your phone easier.

en-US.description: A helper application designed to make using your phone easier.
en-US.longDescription: babblevoice Desktop is a helper application designed to make using your phone easier. There are many functions that can be done using the desktop on your PC such as answering calls, transferring calls and picking up calls out of a queue. This document goes through all the features that are available to you on desktop.
en-US.name: babblevoice Desktop for Microsoft Windows™

zh-CN.description: 简化电话操作的辅助应用程序
zh-CN.longDescription: babblevoice 桌面版是一款旨在简化电话操作的辅助应用程序。您可以通过电脑桌面实现多项功能，包括接听来电、转接电话以及从队列中接听来电等。本文档将详细介绍桌面端提供的所有功能特性。
